focus: Past main clause volevo forces imperfect subjunctive venissi (not venga) – English 'I wanted you to come' hides this; add the hook, quote the card.
ero appena arrivato – arrivare takes essere, literally 'I was arrived' where English says 'had'; drop the tense-label lead.
Real mixed conditional here: se avessi studiato (past if) pairs with ora sarei (present result) – quote the card, plain words, no textbook label.
bisogna never takes a subject – 'one must' is baked into the verb; keep it plain and quote bisogna fare attenzione.
Contrast bisogna + infinitive (general necessity) with bisogna che tu parta + subjunctive (aimed at a specific person).
English uses an infinitive ('I want you to come'); Italian needs voglio che + venga – anchor with the card's own voglio che tu venga.
venne a sapere literally 'came to know' = found out – lead with the literal logic, drop the bare 'achievement' label.
viene chiusa = gets closed (the event happening); essere-passive would read as a state – fix the shaky 'regularly' claim, quote viene chiusa.
The se-clause takes fossi, never the conditional – 'se sarei' is the classic English-speaker error; drop the 'Type 2' label.
non riesco a dormire = 'I can't sleep' – Italian frames inability as not-managing rather than potere; quote the card.
è da rifare = 'is to be redone', it still needs doing – gloss the literal logic and quote the card, drop the bare 'necessity' label.
Anchor on the card's ho da fare – avere da + infinitive = things you have to do; ho da fare alone also means 'I'm busy'.
va raccontata = 'must be told' – andare + past participle for obligation; quote va raccontata (tip cites only the infinitive andare, which the card never shows).
The non isn't a negation – a meno che non cambi = 'unless I change'; say dummy non in plain words, keep the subjunctive note.
cerco un hotel che abbia – a hotel you're only hoping exists takes abbia, not ha; plain words, quote the card, no 'antecedent'.
True rule, unanchored – quote ho detto di non preoccuparsi: a reported command becomes di + infinitive.
The gem is piove da tre giorni – present tense + da where English says 'has been raining'; replace the continuare-a gloss with that.
saranno le tre = 'it must be about three' – future tense used for a guess, not future time; drop the textbook label and the off gloss 'they must be'.
Keep the fixed-preposition rule anchored on continuare a discutere; cut from two sibling examples to one.
mi sono fatto aiutare = 'I got someone to help me' – farsi + infinitive means having it done for you; quote the card (tip cites only farsi, which never appears).
